<style>
  :root{
    --graphite:#12151a;
    --steel:#1c2128;
    --plate:#242b34;
    --hairline:#343d49;
    --paper:#eeece4;
    --paper-dim:#c9c7bd;
    /* Voltech brand navy — sampled from the gear mark in the company logo */
    --voltech-navy:#142a5c;
    --voltech-navy-tint:#6e9be0;
    /* Voltech brand green — sampled from the bolt / "TECH" wordmark */
    --voltech-green:#52701c;
    --voltech-green-tint:#7aa02e;
    --text-soft:#a9b0ba;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--graphite);
    color:var(--paper);
    font-family:'Work Sans',sans-serif;
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.55;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,h4{
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.01em;
    margin:0;
    color:var(--paper);
  }
  a{color:inherit;}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  .wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;}
  @media(max-width:640px){.wrap{padding:0 18px;}}

  /* ===== Diamond-plate texture ===== */
  .plate-texture{
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 0, transparent 2px),
      radial-gradient(circle at 60% 70%, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 0, transparent 2px),
      radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 0, transparent 2px),
      radial-gradient(circle at 40% 85%, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 0, transparent 2px);
    background-size:64px 64px;
  }

  /* ===== Top bar ===== */
  .topbar{
    background:var(--steel);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--text-soft);
  }
  .topbar .wrap{
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
    padding-top:8px;padding-bottom:8px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;
  }
  .topbar a{text-decoration:none;}
  .topbar a:hover{color:var(--voltech-green-tint);}
  .topbar-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
  .topbar-right{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;}

  /* ===== Nav ===== */
  nav{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;
    background:rgba(18,21,26,0.95);
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);
  }
  nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:74px;}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none;}
  .brand-mark-chip{
    width:46px;height:46px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    background:var(--paper);border-radius:3px;
  }
  .brand-mark{width:36px;height:36px;}
  .brand-text{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.05;}
  .brand-text b{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:0.03em;color:var(--paper);display:block;font-weight:700;}
  .brand-text span{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:0.16em;color:var(--voltech-navy-tint);font-weight:500;}
  .navlinks{display:flex;gap:30px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;}
  .navlinks a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--text-soft);padding:4px 0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;transition:color .15s, border-color .15s;}
  .navlinks a:hover{color:var(--paper);border-color:var(--voltech-green-tint);}
  .nav-cta{
    background:var(--voltech-green);color:var(--paper);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;
    padding:10px 20px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;
    clip-path:polygon(8px 0,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%,0 8px);
  }
  .nav-cta:hover{background:var(--voltech-green-tint);color:var(--graphite);}
  .navtoggle{display:none;}
  @media(max-width:900px){
    .navlinks{display:none;}
    .navtoggle{display:block;background:none;border:1px solid var(--hairline);color:var(--paper);padding:8px 12px;font-size:20px;}
  }

  /* ===== Hero ===== */
  .hero{
    position:relative;
    background:linear-gradient(155deg,#151a20 0%,#1a2029 55%,#1c2733 100%);
    padding:96px 0 80px;
    overflow:hidden;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);
  }
  .hero::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
    background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,122,31,0.05) 0 2px, transparent 2px 26px);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 0.85fr;gap:60px;align-items:center;position:relative;}
  @media(max-width:900px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px;}}
  .hero-eyebrow{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
    color:var(--voltech-green-tint);font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;letter-spacing:0.04em;
    margin-bottom:22px;
  }
  .hero-eyebrow .dash{width:26px;height:2px;background:var(--voltech-green-tint);}
  .hero h1{
    font-size:52px;line-height:1.06;font-weight:700;
    max-width:640px;
  }
  .hero h1 .accent{color:var(--voltech-green-tint);}
  .hero p.lead{
    margin-top:24px;font-size:17.5px;color:var(--text-soft);max-width:520px;
    font-family:'Work Sans',sans-serif;text-transform:none;
  }
  @media(max-width:640px){.hero h1{font-size:36px;}}
  .hero-actions{margin-top:36px;display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .btn-primary{
    background:var(--voltech-green);color:var(--paper);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;
    padding:15px 28px;text-decoration:none;
    clip-path:polygon(10px 0,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%,0 10px);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--voltech-green-tint);color:var(--graphite);}
  .btn-secondary{
    border:1px solid var(--hairline);color:var(--paper);font-weight:500;font-size:15px;
    padding:15px 28px;text-decoration:none;
  }
  .btn-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--voltech-navy-tint);color:var(--voltech-navy-tint);}

  .hero-panel{
    position:relative;background:var(--plate);border:1px solid var(--hairline);
    padding:26px;
  }
  .hero-panel-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-soft);letter-spacing:0.08em;margin-bottom:16px;text-transform:uppercase;font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;}
  .hero-stat-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);}
  .hero-stat-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .hero-stat-num{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:26px;color:var(--voltech-green-tint);font-weight:600;}
  .hero-stat-label{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--text-soft);max-width:180px;text-align:right;}

  /* ===== Section shared ===== */
  section{padding:88px 0;}
  .section-head{max-width:640px;margin-bottom:52px;}
  .section-num{
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;color:var(--voltech-navy-tint);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;margin-bottom:14px;display:block;
  }
  .section-head h2{font-size:34px;line-height:1.15;}
  .section-head p{color:var(--text-soft);margin-top:16px;font-size:16px;}
  .on-light{background:var(--paper);color:var(--graphite);}
  .on-light h1,.on-light h2,.on-light h3,.on-light h4{color:var(--graphite);}
  .on-light .text-soft{color:#5c5a52;}

  /* ===== About ===== */
  .about{border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);}
  .about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px;}
  @media(max-width:840px){.about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px;}}
  .about h3{font-size:15px;color:var(--voltech-navy-tint);letter-spacing:0.06em;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .about p{color:var(--text-soft);font-size:16px;}
  .why-list{list-style:none;margin:18px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px 20px;}
  .why-list li{display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--paper);align-items:flex-start;}
  .why-list li::before{
    content:"";width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--voltech-green-tint);margin-top:7px;flex:none;
    transform:rotate(45deg);
  }
  @media(max-width:500px){.why-list{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ===== Division blocks with individual product cubes ===== */
  .division-block{padding:44px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);}
  .division-block:first-child{border-top:none;padding-top:0;}
  .division-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:20px;margin-bottom:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .division-num{font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;font-size:44px;font-weight:700;color:var(--hairline);line-height:1;flex:none;}
  .division-head h3{font-size:22px;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .division-head p{color:var(--text-soft);font-size:14.5px;max-width:600px;}
  .cube-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(128px,1fr));gap:14px;}
  .cube{
    background:var(--steel);border:1px solid var(--hairline);overflow:hidden;
    transition:transform .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
  }
  .cube:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--voltech-green-tint);}
  .cube-img{line-height:0;background:#fff;}
  .cube-img img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
  .cube-label{padding:9px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--paper);text-align:center;line-height:1.3;}

  /* ===== Featured equipment ===== */
  .feat{background:var(--paper);color:var(--graphite);}
  .feat-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center;padding:56px 0;border-top:1px solid #d6d4c9;}
  .feat-item:first-of-type{border-top:none;padding-top:0;}
  @media(max-width:860px){.feat-item{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px;}}
  .feat-item.reverse .feat-media{order:2;}
  @media(max-width:860px){.feat-item.reverse .feat-media{order:0;}}
  .feat-media img{width:100%;border:1px solid #d6d4c9;}
  .feat-media-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
  .feat-tag{
    display:inline-block;background:var(--voltech-navy);color:#e4ebf7;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;padding:5px 12px;margin-bottom:16px;text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .feat-body h3{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:14px;color:var(--graphite);}
  .feat-body p{color:#5c5a52;font-size:15.5px;margin-bottom:20px;}
  .spec-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px;margin-top:6px;}
  .spec-table tr{border-bottom:1px solid #d6d4c9;}
  .spec-table tr:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .spec-table td{padding:9px 0;}
  .spec-table td:first-child{color:#807d70;width:46%;}
  .spec-table td:last-child{font-weight:600;color:var(--graphite);}

  .diagram-box{border:1px solid #d6d4c9;background:#e4e2d8;padding:20px;}
  .diagram-box svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}
  .diagram-caption{font-size:12px;color:#807d70;margin-top:10px;text-align:center;letter-spacing:0.03em;}

  /* ===== Industries ===== */
  .ind-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1px;background:var(--hairline);border:1px solid var(--hairline);}
  .ind-chip{
    background:var(--steel);flex:1 1 150px;padding:24px 18px;text-align:center;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  }
  .ind-chip svg{width:26px;height:26px;color:var(--voltech-navy-tint);}

  /* ===== Brands ===== */
  .brand-strip{border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);padding:36px 0;}
  .brand-strip .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .brand-strip .lbl{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-soft);letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;flex:none;}
  .brand-pill-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;flex:1;}
  .brand-pill{border:1px solid var(--hairline);color:var(--paper);font-size:13.5px;padding:7px 14px;font-weight:500;}

  /* ===== CTA / Contact ===== */
  .cta{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--voltech-navy),#1c2733);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);
  }
  .cta-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:50px;}
  @media(max-width:860px){.cta-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .cta h2{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .cta p{color:#c7d3dd;font-size:16px;max-width:460px;}
  .contact-card{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.2);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);padding:30px;}
  .contact-row{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);}
  .contact-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .contact-row svg{width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--voltech-green-tint);flex:none;margin-top:2px;}
  .contact-row a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;}
  .contact-row a:hover{color:var(--voltech-green-tint);}
  .contact-row .lbl2{font-size:12px;color:#9db0bf;letter-spacing:0.04em;text-transform:uppercase;display:block;margin-bottom:2px;}

  footer{padding:34px 0;background:var(--graphite);}
  footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-soft);}

  .badge-india{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid var(--hairline);padding:6px 14px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-soft);
  }
  .badge-india svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--voltech-green-tint);}

  /* ===== Floating WhatsApp button (desktop + mobile) ===== */
  .float-whatsapp{
    position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:80;
    width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;
    background:#25D366;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);text-decoration:none;
    border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
  }
  .float-whatsapp svg{width:28px;height:28px;fill:#fff;}
  .float-whatsapp:hover{background:#1ebe59;}

  /* ===== Sticky mobile call/WhatsApp bar ===== */
  .mobile-cta-bar{display:none;}
  @media(max-width:640px){
    .float-whatsapp{right:16px;bottom:74px;width:50px;height:50px;}
    .float-whatsapp svg{width:24px;height:24px;}
    .mobile-cta-bar{
      display:flex;position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:79;
      border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);
    }
    .mobile-cta-bar a{
      flex:1;text-align:center;padding:14px 8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;
      text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
    }
    .mobile-cta-bar a svg{width:17px;height:17px;}
    .mobile-cta-bar .call{background:var(--voltech-navy);color:#e4ebf7;}
    .mobile-cta-bar .wa{background:#1ebe59;color:#fff;}
    body{padding-bottom:54px;}
  }

  /* ===== Quote form ===== */
  .quote-form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;margin-top:26px;}
  .quote-form .row2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;}
  @media(max-width:520px){.quote-form .row2{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .quote-form label{font-size:12.5px;color:#9db0bf;letter-spacing:0.04em;text-transform:uppercase;display:block;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .quote-form input,.quote-form textarea{
    width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    color:var(--paper);padding:11px 13px;font-family:'Work Sans',sans-serif;font-size:14.5px;
  }
  .quote-form input::placeholder,.quote-form textarea::placeholder{color:#7c8a97;}
  .quote-form input:focus,.quote-form textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--voltech-green-tint);border-color:transparent;}
  .quote-form textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:84px;}
  .quote-form .form-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:4px;}
  .form-btn{
    border:none;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;padding:13px 22px;cursor:pointer;
    text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  }
  .form-btn svg{width:17px;height:17px;}
  .form-btn.wa-btn{background:#25D366;color:#08300f;}
  .form-btn.wa-btn:hover{background:#1ebe59;}
  .form-btn.mail-btn{background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);color:var(--paper);}
  .form-btn.mail-btn:hover{border-color:var(--voltech-green-tint);color:var(--voltech-green-tint);}
  .form-note{font-size:12.5px;color:#8b9aa8;margin-top:2px;}
</style>
</head>

<section id="equipment" class="feat">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-num" style="color:var(--voltech-navy)">Engineered &amp; Fabricated</span>
      <h2>Equipment we build in-house.</h2>
      <p class="text-soft">Beyond trading, our own workshop fabricates mobile cranes, stainless manifolds, custom automation fixtures and belt conveyors to client drawings and duty specs.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="feat-item">
      <div class="feat-media">
        <div class="diagram-box">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 460 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

            <path d="M410 60 L410 250" stroke="#807d70" stroke-width="1"/>
            <text x="418" y="160" font-family="Work Sans" font-size="12" fill="#807d70" transform="rotate(90 418 160)" text-anchor="middle">Max Height — 2.0 mtr</text>

      <div class="feat-body">
        <span class="feat-tag">Fabricated Equipment</span>
        <h3>Manual Mobile Crane — 2 Ton</h3>
        <p>A shop-floor floor crane for engine pulls, die changes and spot lifts where a fixed gantry doesn't reach. Telescopic slider boom extends the reach on demand; the whole unit rolls on nylon/PU wheels for tight aisles.</p>
        <table class="spec-table">
          <tr><td>Lifting capacity</td><td>2 Ton (2000 kg)</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Max. lifting height</td><td>2.0 mtr</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Tyre to tyre width</td><td>1.0 mtr</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Overall length</td><td>1.8 mtr (1.15–2.35 mtr boom travel)</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Boom type / movement</td><td>Slider (telescopic), manual slide-out</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Operation</td><td>Manual hydraulic pump, single hook</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Material / finish</td><td>MS structural steel, industrial paint</td></tr>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="feat-item reverse">
      <div class="feat-media">
        <div class="feat-media-pair">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Stainless steel multi-port manifold with red-handled ball valves">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Manifold rear view showing mounting brackets and single inlet/outlet">
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="feat-body">
        <span class="feat-tag">Fabricated Equipment</span>
        <h3>Multi-Port SS304 Distribution Manifold</h3>
        <p>Built to order for air, water and utility distribution lines — one inlet, one outlet, and as many ball-valved take-off ports as the line needs. Every nipple on a run is identical, so spares and maintenance stay simple.</p>
        <table class="spec-table">
          <tr><td>Configuration</td><td>10-port, single inlet / single outlet</td></tr>

<section class="cta" id="contact">
  <div class="wrap cta-grid">
    <div>
      <span class="section-num" style="color:var(--voltech-green-tint)">Get In Touch</span>
      <h2>Need any industrial product? We source it. We supply it. You focus on your business.</h2>
      <p>Send us a part number, a spec sheet, or a rough sketch of what you need built — our team will quote sourcing or fabrication within one working day.</p>
      <div style="margin-top:20px;"><span class="badge-india"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M12 2l3 6 6 1-4.5 4.5L18 20l-6-3.5L6 20l1.5-6.5L3 9l6-1z"/></svg>All-India Supply, based in Vadodara</span></div>

      <form class="quote-form" id="quoteForm" action="https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID" method="POST">
        <div class="row2">
          <div>
            <label for="qf-name">Your name</label>
            <input id="qf-name" name="name" type="text" placeholder="e.g. Rakesh Patel" required>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label for="qf-phone">Phone number</label>
            <input id="qf-phone" name="phone" type="tel" placeholder="e.g. 98765 43210" required>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label for="qf-need">What do you need?</label>
          <input id="qf-need" name="requirement" type="text" placeholder="e.g. 10-port SS manifold, 500 pcs push-in fittings, 2-ton mobile crane">
        </div>
        <div>
          <label for="qf-msg">Details (optional)</label>
          <textarea id="qf-msg" name="message" placeholder="Quantity, specification, delivery location, timeline..."></textarea>
        </div>
        <div class="form-actions">
          <button type="submit" class="form-btn wa-btn" id="qf-submit">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><line x1="22" y1="2" x2="11" y2="13"/><polygon points="22 2 15 22 11 13 2 9 22 2"/></svg>
            <span id="qf-submit-label">Send Enquiry</span>
          </button>
        </div>
        <p class="form-note" id="qf-status">We'll get back to you within one working day.</p>
      </form>
    </div>
    <div class="contact-card">
      <div class="contact-row">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 01-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 01-8.63-3.07 19.5 19.5 0 01-6-6 19.79 19.79 0 01-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 014.11 2h3a2 2 0 012 1.72c.127.96.362 1.903.7 2.81a2 2 0 01-.45 2.11L8.09 9.91a16 16 0 006 6l1.27-1.27a2 2 0 012.11-.45c.907.338 1.85.573 2.81.7A2 2 0 0122 16.92z"/></svg>
        <div><span class="lbl2">Call</span><a href="tel:+919274463965">+91 92744 63965</a></div>
      </div>
      <div class="contact-row">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M4 4h16v16H4z" opacity="0"/><path d="M22 6l-10 7L2 6"/><rect x="2" y="4" width="20" height="16" rx="2"/></svg>
        <div><span class="lbl2">Email</span><a href="mailto:info.voltechindustrial@gmail.com">info.voltechindustrial@gmail.com</a></div>
      </div>
      <div class="contact-row">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M21 10c0 7-9 12-9 12s-9-5-9-12a9 9 0 0118 0z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg>
        <div><span class="lbl2">Location</span><span style="font-weight:600;">Vadodara, Gujarat, India</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div>© 2026 Voltech Industrial Solution. All rights reserved.</div>
    <div>Reliable products. Right solutions. Strong partnerships.</div>
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
  (function(){
    var form = document.getElementById('quoteForm');
    if(!form) return;
    var submitBtn = document.getElementById('qf-submit');
    var submitLabel = document.getElementById('qf-submit-label');
    var status = document.getElementById('qf-status');

    form.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      if(!form.checkValidity()){
        form.reportValidity();
        return;
      }
      submitBtn.disabled = true;
      submitLabel.textContent = 'Sending...';
      status.textContent = 'Sending your enquiry...';
      status.style.color = '';

      var data = new FormData(form);
      fetch(form.action, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: data,
        headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
      }).then(function(response){
        if(response.ok){
          form.reset();
          submitLabel.textContent = 'Enquiry Sent';
          status.textContent = 'Thanks — your enquiry has been received. We\'ll get back to you within one working day.';
          status.style.color = 'var(--voltech-green-tint)';
        } else {
          throw new Error('Submission failed');
        }
      }).catch(function(){
        submitBtn.disabled = false;
        submitLabel.textContent = 'Send Enquiry';
        status.textContent = 'Something went wrong — please call or WhatsApp us directly at +91 92744 63965.';
        status.style.color = '#ff8f8f';
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>
